# Sprint Recap

The team shipped the update on Friday afternoon after a short review cycle. Only one small bug turned up during testing, and it was fixed within the hour. Rollback was never needed because the new version behaved exactly as expected in staging.

Feedback from the on-call engineer was positive. The dashboard now loads noticeably faster for most customers, and no new alerts fired overnight. Next sprint will focus on cleaning up the remaining test flakiness before the holiday freeze.
